definitions.BREAD: A foodstuff made by baking dough made from cereals.
definitions.MILK: A white liquid produced by the mammary glands of female mammals to nourish their young.
definitions.EGGS: An approximately spherical or ellipsoidal body produced by birds, reptiles, insects and other animals, housing the embryo during its development.
definitions.RICE: Cereal plants, Oryza sativa of the grass family whose seeds are used as food.
definitions.MEAT: The flesh (muscle tissue) of an animal used as food.
definitions.FISH: A cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills.
definitions.FRUIT: (often in the plural) In general, a product of plant growth useful to man or animals.
definitions.CAKE: A rich, sweet dessert food, typically made of flour, sugar and eggs and baked in an oven, and often covered in icing.
definitions.PIE: A type of pastry that consists of an outer crust and a filling.
definitions.SOUP: Any of various dishes commonly made by combining liquids, such as water or stock with other ingredients, such as meat and vegetables, that contribute flavor and texture.
definitions.APPLE: A common, round fruit produced by the tree Malus domestica, cultivated in temperate climates.
definitions.PEAR: An edible fruit produced by the pear tree, similar to an apple but elongated towards the stem.
definitions.BANANA: An elongated curved tropical fruit that grows in bunches and has a creamy flesh and a smooth skin.
definitions.GRAPE: A small, round, smooth-skinned edible fruit, usually purple, red, or green, that grows in bunches on vines of genus Vitis.
definitions.PEACH: A tree (Prunus persica), native to China and now widely cultivated throughout temperate regions, having pink flowers and edible fruit.
definitions.LIME: Any inorganic material containing calcium, usually calcium oxide (quicklime) or calcium hydroxide (slaked lime).
definitions.SEED: A fertilized and ripened ovule, containing an embryonic plant.
definitions.CORN: The main cereal plant grown for its grain in a given region, such as oats in parts of Scotland and Ireland, and wheat or barley in England and Wales.
definitions.PEA: A plant, Pisum sativum, member of the legume (Fabaceae) family.
definitions.BEAN: A reusable software component written in Java.
definitions.ONION: A monocotyledonous plant (Allium cepa), allied to garlic, used as vegetable and spice.
definitions.POTATO: The tuber of a plant, Solanum tuberosum, eaten as a starchy vegetable, particularly in the Americas and Europe; this plant.
definitions.CARROT: A vegetable with a nutritious, juicy, sweet root that is often orange in colour, Daucus carota, especially the subspecies sativus in the family Apiaceae.
definitions.TOMATO: A widely cultivated plant, Solanum lycopersicum, having edible fruit.
definitions.SALAD: A food made primarily of a mixture of raw or cold ingredients, typically vegetables, usually served with a dressing such as vinegar or mayonnaise.
definitions.SALT: A common substance, chemically consisting mainly of sodium chloride (NaCl), used extensively as a condiment and preservative.
definitions.SPICE: Aromatic or pungent plant matter (usually dried) used to season or flavour food.
definitions.SUGAR: Sucrose in the form of small crystals, obtained from sugar cane or sugar beet and used to sweeten food and drink.
definitions.HONEY: A viscous, sweet fluid produced from plant nectar by bees.
definitions.SWEET: The basic taste sensation induced by sugar.
definitions.SOUR: The sensation of a sour taste.
definitions.BITTER: (usually in the plural bitters) A liquid or powder, made from bitter herbs, used in mixed drinks or as a tonic.
definitions.TASTY: Having a pleasant or satisfying flavor; delicious.
definitions.FRESH: A rush of water, along a river or onto the land; a flood.
definitions.HOT: (with up) To heat; to make or become hot.
definitions.COLD: (of a thing) Having a low temperature.
definitions.FOOD: Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life.
definitions.LUNCH: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day.
definitions.DINNER: A midday meal (in a context in which the evening meal is called supper or tea).
definitions.MEAL: Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity (as opposed to a snack).
definitions.CHEESE: A dairy product made from curdled or cultured milk.
definitions.BUTTER: A soft, fatty foodstuff made by churning the cream of milk (generally cow's milk).
definitions.CREAM: The butterfat/milkfat part of milk which rises to the top; this part when separated from the remainder.
definitions.YOGURT: A milk-based product stiffened by a bacterium-aided curdling process, and sometimes mixed with fruit or other flavoring.
definitions.PASTA: Dough made from wheat and water and sometimes mixed with egg and formed into various shapes; often sold in dried form and typically boiled for eating.
definitions.PIZZA: A baked Italian dish of a thinly rolled bread dough crust typically topped before baking with tomato sauce, cheese and other ingredients such as meat, vegetables or fruit.
definitions.STEAK: Beefsteak, a slice of beef, broiled or cut for broiling.
definitions.CHICKEN: A domestic fowl, Gallus gallus, especially when young.
definitions.BACON: Cured meat from the sides, belly or back of a pig.
definitions.SAUSAGE: A food made of ground meat (or meat substitute) and seasoning, packed in a section of the animal's intestine, or in a similarly cylindrical shaped synthetic casing; a length of this food.
definitions.SHRIMP: Any of many swimming, often edible crustaceans, chiefly of the infraorder Caridea or the suborder Dendrobranchiata, with slender legs, long whiskers and a long abdomen.
definitions.CRAB: A crustacean of the infraorder Brachyura, having five pairs of legs, the foremost of which are in the form of claws, and a carapace.
definitions.LOBSTER: A crustacean of the Nephropidae family, dark green or blue-black in colour turning bright red when cooked, with a hard shell and claws, which is used as a seafood.
definitions.SALMON: One of several species of fish, typically of the Salmoninae subfamily, brownish above with silvery sides and delicate pinkish-orange flesh; they ascend rivers to spawn.
definitions.TUNA: Any of several species of fish of the genus Thunnus in the family Scombridae.
definitions.SPINACH: A particular edible plant, Spinacia oleracea, or its leaves.
definitions.BROCCOLI: A plant, Brassica oleracea var. italica, of the cabbage family, Brassicaceae; especially, the tree-shaped flower and stalk that are eaten as a vegetable.
definitions.CABBAGE: An edible plant (Brassica oleracea var. capitata) having a head of green leaves.
definitions.LETTUCE: An edible plant, Lactuca sativa and its close relatives, having a head of green and/or purple leaves.
definitions.CUCUMBER: A vine in the gourd family, Cucumis sativus.
definitions.PEPPER: A plant of the family Piperaceae.
definitions.GARLIC: A plant, Allium sativum, related to the onion, having a pungent bulb much used in cooking.
definitions.GINGER: The pungent aromatic rhizome of a tropical Asian herb, Zingiber officinale, used as a spice and as a stimulant and acarminative.
definitions.PARSLEY: A bright green, biennial herb, Petroselinum crispum, having many cultivars.
definitions.MINT: A building or institution where money (originally, only coins) is produced under government licence.
definitions.ROSEMARY: A shrub, Rosmarinus officinalis, that originates from Europe and Asia Minor and produces a fragrant herb used in cooking and perfumes.
definitions.THYME: Any plant of the labiate genus Thymus, such as the garden thyme, Thymus vulgaris, a warm, pungent aromatic, that is much used to give a relish to seasoning and soups.
definitions.OREGANO: A herb of the mint family, Origanum vulgare, having aromatic leaves.
definitions.CINNAMON: A small evergreen tree native to Sri Lanka and southern India, Cinnamomum verum or Cinnamomum zeylanicum, belonging to the family Lauraceae.
definitions.VANILLA: Any tropical, climbing orchid of the genus Vanilla (especially Vanilla planifolia), bearing podlike fruit yielding an extract used in flavoring food or in perfumes.
definitions.CHOCOLATE: A food made from ground roasted cocoa beans.
definitions.CANDY: Edible, sweet-tasting confectionery containing sugar, or sometimes artificial sweeteners, and often flavored with fruit, chocolate, nuts, herbs and spices, or artificial flavors.
definitions.COOKIE: A small, flat, baked good which is either crisp or soft but firm.
definitions.DONUT: A deep-fried piece of dough or batter, commonly made in a toroidal or ellipsoidal shape, and mixed with various sweeteners and flavors, sometimes filled with jelly, custard or cream.
definitions.MUFFIN: A type of flattish bun, usually cut in two horizontally, toasted and spread with butter, etc, before being eaten.
definitions.PANCAKE: A thin batter cake fried in a pan or on a griddle in oil or butter.
definitions.WAFFLE: A flat pastry pressed with a grid pattern.
definitions.CEREAL: A type of grass (such as wheat, rice or oats) cultivated for its edible grains.
definitions.OATMEAL: Meal made from rolled or round oats.
definitions.GRANOLA: A breakfast and snack food consisting of loose, crispy pellets made of nuts, rolled oats, honey and other natural ingredients.
definitions.BAGEL: A toroidal bread roll that is boiled before it is baked.
definitions.SANDWICH: A dish or foodstuff where two or more slices of bread serve as the wrapper or container of some other food.
definitions.WRAP: To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.
definitions.BURRITO: A Mexican dish consisting of a flour tortilla wrapped around a filling of meat and/or beans, cheese etc.
definitions.SUSHI: A Japanese dish made of small portions of sticky white rice flavored with vinegar, usually wrapped in seaweed and filled or topped with fish, vegetables or meat.
definitions.RAMEN: Soup noodles of wheat, with various ingredients (Japanese style).
definitions.NOODLE: (usually in the plural) a string or strip of pasta.
definitions.CURRY: One of a family of dishes originating from South Asian cuisine, flavoured by a spiced sauce.
definitions.CHILI: The pungent, spicy fresh or dried fruit of any of several cultivated varieties of capsicum peppers, used in cooking.
definitions.QUICHE: A pie made primarily of eggs and cream in a pastry crust.
